The role manages their workload and project contributions independently and collaborates closely with Administrators and other technical teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of FortisBC’s infrastructure environments. Advanced knowledge of infrastructure systems including data center operations, networking, and Unified Communications. Experience leading troubleshooting and resolution of complex infrastructure issues. Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring, automation, and orchestration tools. Experienced with Windows Server and Endpoint Patching and Management. Interested in automation.
